notes.title: Game Announcement - Secret Agent Wizard Boy and the International Crime Syndicate
notes.content:
DEMO AVAILABLE NOW!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3281870/Secret_Agent_Wizard_Boy_and_the_International_Crime_Syndicate_Demo/

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38528668/7362ade645c19a49bb02640e8115533bb18702dd.png

Secret Agendas. . .
Secret Agent Wizard Boy was a normal Wizard Boy on his way to his first year at Wizard School until he received a message from MI6.

"Wizard Boy," it said. "We've received intel that the headmaster of Wizard School, Grumblemort, is the leader of a criminal organization named S.P.I.D.E.R. We need you to investigate!"

And so Wizard Boy started his first year at Wizard School, trying to uncover the mysteries that lay before him.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38528668/6193717666145158acbcf0e3c93d36c23f2c98a4.png

Secret Agent Wizard Boy is a sandbox wizard sim that can be played alone or in cooperative(?) multiplayer. Explore (blow up) the castle, find secrets, solve puzzles, and discover the mystery hidden deep in the castle.

Features

 A multitude of spells to learn and inflict on others
 Physics-based mayhem
 Open-ended goals to accomplish (or ignore) however you see fit
 Online multiplayer
 Retro-themed third person action, straight from the days of Unreal Engine 1
 Landmines


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38528668/1a706856e6cb9c0173ac8127a325c213ec8f0a37.png

. . . And the demo is available to play right now! Go take a look!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3281870/Secret_Agent_Wizard_Boy_and_the_International_Crime_Syndicate_Demo/

notes.title: New Game Released! Exiled - Ancient Puzzle Thriller
notes.content:
A New Game: Exiled

Charlotte is missing. A note has been left on her desk talking of "the ancient evil" and "banishment to a different realm." The eldritch tome and an untranslated scrap she had been studying act as the only clues to her disappearance. Use clues found in the book to translate an ancient language, evade the lurking horrors, and solve the mystery of the strange objects around you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/a53b5dd1234596509197b2e5b6293695551e47d6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/1aa662c879a1eb4fb48d6e8bd2bd070214875145.png

This is a compact, detailed puzzle thriller similar to The Room and Myst. The player can inspect items, use clues, and slowly crack the mystery of the Great Library.


Solve ancient puzzles, decode an eldritch language, and avoid the lurking horror all while sitting at a single desk
Tense and foreboding atmosphere where the stillness of the library can be shattered at any moment
High level of interactivity
Multiple endings
Good for a single play session
Voiceover by Tom Schalk


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/97c4a8cf83bd3f8ec00e5efe303c72e2878e24ca.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/ba1e6a65a44cab78a92941678c1efd7287e30764.png

Go check it out! It would really mean a lot to me! :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2741620/Exiled/

notes.title: Kyle is COMPLETE
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
It's a BIG day for Kyle. You see, Kyle is now... COMPLETE
[previewyoutube=6oi9ParvI8g;full][/previewyoutube]
Back in 2019 when Ducky released Kyle is Famous as a fun, free project here on Steam, he had no idea how popular it would get and how much people would love Kyle.

So he came to us at New Blood and said... do you want to make Kyle... Complete? And we said... 
YES OF COURSE WHATEVER THAT MEANS WE'RE 100% IN.

BEHOLD...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/1ca1272349d5dce4e21f888d3c257b9a5acce62c.jpg

The COMPLETE Edition of Kyle is Famous now includes:

 More than 117 endings + All the original Kyle DLC (You're a hot dog!)
 Over 2000+ lines of voice acted dialogue by Gianni (He's funny!)
 A custom story editor with Steam Workshop (Oh boy, mods!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/e518a29ab6972cc1334cf81b61e88ba2277f6d66.png
 Twitch Integration (Twitch plays Kyle?!)
 Tons of new visuals, sounds, and more! (Shazam!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/02ac46db5a43f42c3098e17165b5f3ee42104bbc.jpg
But wait... there's more!

Everyone who had the original FREE version of Kyle has now been UPGRADED to the Kyle is Famous: Free Edition. It's kinda the same... but different! And better!

This version of the game has all the content of the old version but looks and plays like the Complete Edition! But no new endings, voice acting or fancy new features. It does have Twitch integration though! And of course you can still play all your original Kyle DLC. UPGRADE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/3fc60dd7961d036891e70f980354c777d9c917e2.jpg

Speaking of those of you who want to UPGRADE to the COMPLETE EDITION of Kyle, know that Steam might give you this warning about that - but rest assured you can mash your face into the PURCHASE button and it will indeed give you the shiny new version of Kyle. We promise.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/8d5c976e884e9b58e8c7179e4b34652a7702379d.png

Thank you so much for supporting Kyle, Ducky and New Blood as we made Kyle... Complete. If you love Kyle as much as we love Kyle, be sure to tell a friend, family member, or your favorite loud mouthed internet celebrity, Kyle would love that.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1186740/Kyle_is_Famous_Complete_Edition/

notes.title: My Next Game: My Friendly Neighborhood
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11106370/bab1f1a4cc6249ff033db74ae6ed411b017e5892.png
Survival Horror, but with Puppets
Hey guys! I am super happy to report that I finally have a brand new project to share. Ever wonder what your favorite children's TV shows would look like with a dash of survival horror? MFN is the marriage of survival horror and puppets, giving you an open world to fight through and explore, big mysteries to solve, puzzles out the whazoo, and a ton more.

So what sort of things should you expect to find in My Friendly Neighborhood?


Non-linear, first person survival horror gameplay
A colorful cast of puppet friends turned adversaries (and maybe turned friends again!)
An array of puzzles in the vein of the survival horror greats.
A multitude of diverse environments, from the "BTS" Ray's Workshop to cardboard crayon halls
A grid-based real-time inventory, cause that's just way better
And a lot more. . . but I'll let you find that out for yourself

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11106370/8bbdc83d1a86f9f9920be5dd81ea064ca62d012d.gif

Also, just a note - it might be a horror game, but expect the same sort of playful, humorous take on things that you might have found in my other games. It's spooky, but I think you'll find a lot of smiles along the way. :)

I'm really happy to report that this is by far the biggest project I've ever worked on. I have a TON of great stuff planned that I can't wait for you all to experience. . . but I'll let you find all of that for yourselves.

Could You do me a Favor?
If you're interested, could you drop a wishlist on the Steam page? That's by far the best way to support the game, and by extension me too! :) Thanks for reading! Hope to see you. . . IN THE NEIGHBORHOOD!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1574260/My_Friendly_Neighborhood/

notes.content:

I've added in a new set of endings relating to withering away while in bed. I've always thought that part of the game was a little lacking, and now it's been fleshed out to give some extra dimension to that choice. :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/8a916771ae2bfafb7d31495952233e20c18f4fc8.gif

If you missed it before, I also recently added in a new set of endings inside of the interview where Kyle decides that he's going to become. . . Rachel May herself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/fa732300af4fe2f6937582d2f1eb9e810410abf0.gif

Hope you guys like the new content! Keep posted for more!

notes.title: Kyle is Hotdog - RELEASED TO THE WORLD!!!
notes.content:
Kyle is Hotdog has RELEASED!!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/fd7413d663f001caf9a81472c137e73e0b05c617.png

Kyle has woken up today and realized something incredibly important. Kyle is bored, and is ready for something new and exciting to enter his life. Kyle decides to pursue his childhood passion of hotdog sales, preparing instead for a day on the streets instead of an interview with Rachel.

22 New Endings. . .
Kyle is Hotdog expands Kyle's pre-existing world to include 22 new endings, including the eating of the entire leprechaun pit, moving Tyler around from inside of himself to boost hotdog sales, traveling to foreign dimensions, writing love letters to old high-school crushes. . . and maybe, if you look hard enough, a little look into Kyle's character himself. . . (but you didn't hear that from me).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/5896f0e0e7e1ed6075e46d3855871fd6462a5fda.gif

Available Now!!!
Kyle is Hotdog is available to play now for roughly the price of a hotdog. This was something I made from a love of the project and the characters, and I am SO excited for you all to crawl through and find all the secrets I've hidden around. :)

Go give it a look! :) I love each and every one of you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263080/Kyle_is_Hotdog/

notes.title: Kyle is Santa - Holiday Expansion | Wishlist Now!
notes.content:
Kyle's Expanded Adventure. . .
Kyle wakes up, realizing that he now can be imbued with the spirit of Christmas. After spewing elves out of his stomach and being tormented with the voices of children, Kyle walks through his world with a new set of goals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/045560eebcd5246045b18e2ee4aa120918dcff4d.png

11 New Endings and More. . .
Kyle has 11 new holiday-centered endings to explore. Release elves upon the world, give gifts to the kids, and possibly even conduct an interview as. . . someone new? New interactions with old characters and items included.

Alpha Access
Kyle is Santa is planned for release on Steam December 13th. However, if you want to play RIGHT NOW, Kyle is Santa is already released in alpha on my Patreon. Feel free to check it out, or drop by the Steam page below!
